0: A new season with sets for Clockwerk, Treant Protector and Windranger.
1: Changes to Treant Protector, Bounty Hunter and Earth Spirit. You can no longer hide in the cave textures near the top Roshan pit, Bounty Hunter's Big Game Hunter was fixed, followed by 11 more old bugs.
2: PlayTime loaned out bottega — the player is heading to an international mix for practice. 343, formerly OG's coach, now leads Xipto Esports.
3: Team Tidebound is back in Dota
4: PARIVISION bought Satanic from Team Spirit
One of the loudest transfers of the off-season.
5: Team Yandex wins BLAST SLAM VIII
The podium repeated The International 2026. Yandex is called the main contender to dominate the new season.
6: Personal discounts found in the game files
Dataminers dug up hints of personal offers and discounts on paid content. How it will work is still unknown.
7: Fixes for Lina and a teleport effect
A bug with one of Lina's abilities and a custom teleport effect was fixed.
8: Trove of Terror treasure is out
Inside: 15 Immortal sets, a new Tidehunter arcana and a re-release of the formerly exclusive Drow Ranger arcana.
9: New Terrorblade set now works with the arcana
A conflict between the new Terrorblade set and the Fractal Horns of Inner Abysm arcana was fixed.
10: Dota 2's peak online passed one million people.
11: Trove of Terror sets can now be gifted
Valve allowed gifting sets from the treasure and handed out extra chests for duplicates.
12: The tournament runs from October 18 to November 5 with a $100,000 prize pool.
13: Xtreme Gaming heads to BLAST SLAM IX
XG beat Team Resilience in the final Chinese qualifier and took the slot.
14: Western Europe — OG and Team Lynx, Eastern Europe — Yellow Submarine, China — Team Resilience, SEA — a stack of MidOne, Ghost and Royal Bear, Americas — Parker's mix and Skyreavers. The last three slots will be decided at DreamLeague Division 2.
15: Nix will work at the League of Legends Worlds
The commentator is going to the LoL World Championship — Riot invited him as a community streamer.
16: He plays with Lorenof and DM. At PARI Universe the roster competes as Astra Invicta.
17: The TI champion admitted he's burned out and wants to leave the pro scene. He's open to a coaching role on a strong team.
18: Team Spirit wanted to sign Noticed
According to Korb3n, after Collapse left, Spirit tried to sign Noticed, but the deal fell through — the team picked up batyuk instead.
19: The move is no longer a rumor. With him, Liquid can challenge Team Yandex, PARIVISION and Team Spirit. What happens to Nisha is still unclear.
20: Bounty Hunter is the king of the meta
In pubs BH is the sole leader of the top tier, and at BLAST Slam VIII he was picked or banned in 95% of drafts. Pros also favor Rubick, Batrider, Puck, Ember Spirit, Tiny and Clockwerk.
21: Along with Trove of Terror, the Necronomicon recipe was updated in the game files: it's now Staff of Wizardry + Belt of Strength instead of two Sage's Masks. The item itself was removed back in 7.29 (2021). Valve hasn't confirmed a return.
22: Fixes for the Tidehunter arcana and Baby Roshan
Animations of the new Tidehunter arcana and the Baby Roshan model were fixed.
23: A bug with Lil' Shredder projectiles was fixed, along with FPS drops.
24: Primal Beast gets ability effect slots
You can now equip separate cosmetic effects on the beast's abilities.
25: A hint in the avoid list
The client's avoid list was updated: you can now see right away how many free slots it has.
26: The former pro thinks you don't need to invent anything now — playing by timings is enough.
27: The former Falcons player lost his first duel, complained about organizers talking in Discord, waited an hour and a half for the next match — and simply left the tournament.
28: TopSon nominated for The Streamer Awards
He was nominated for best MOBA streamer of the year.
29: A fan is making a pixel Dota in the browser
A developer on Reddit showed a prototype of 2D Dota right in the browser. By the way, we have our own pixel 1x6 Arena in the "Games" tab.
30: Korb3n: why CIS is the strongest region
The coach broke down why CIS is ahead right now and which region could compete with it.
31: Rue told how he got into Team Spirit
No secret: he just played, and they invited him to the team. After that, he says, things took off. Korb3n added that preparation wins, not motivation.
32: Saksa on Team Yandex's online failures
The support admitted that at home not everyone takes online tournaments seriously — hence the losses. At LANs the team delivers.
33: Yatoro: a coach matters more than a new player
The carry thinks changing the coach changes a team more than replacing a player: the coach shapes the draft, the rotations and how the team sees the game.
34: 208 days have passed since the last major update — the second-longest patch in history. If Valve stays silent for 32 more days, 7.41 will overtake record holder 7.32, which lasted 240 days.
35: Malr1ne: calling shots in pubs isn't necessary
In his words, calls make sense closer to nine thousand MMR, and even there people often don't listen. His advice: just play on instinct.
36: The pro is trying out Pudge through the jungle — with his own starting items and follow-up purchases. Brace yourselves, pubs.
37: Collapse and Miposhka have been spotted in his stack. No details yet.
38: The legendary organization that SumaiL and Arteezy played for is shutting down on November 2, 2026. The reason: few sponsors and rising costs. All EG players are free to negotiate with other teams.
40: Hints of a second act of "The Dark Carnival"

The experimental client contains alternative creep models, nine new tickets named after Tarot cards (The Chariot, The Moon, The Tower…), a Cog item for upgrading items or abilities and a wagon creation tool. Valve hasn't given dates.
41: New hero Arjun — just a rumor for now
The most discussed rumor of the season. A mini-game called Item Battler is mentioned alongside it. Valve hasn't announced the hero: no art, no date.
42: New maps found in the client
The maps dota_mid and dota_keen appeared in the game files, plus a door object on the main river. What they're for is still unknown.
43: There's no official date. Patch trackers give a high chance of a release in October–November. The community is torn between Halloween (October 31) and the period before DreamLeague Season 30 (December 2–13).
44: Xibbe will play for Team Yandex instead of ATF, who will miss the first matches of the tournament due to minor health issues. 4nalog replaces Stojkov in Legion.
